Why NanaFlow

Open, start, focus — then get back to work.

No projects, tags or to-do lists to set up first. NanaFlow does one thing — timing your focus — and stays quietly out of the way.

One compact window

Switch between the timer and statistics in the same small window, without taking over your screen.

Always in the menu bar

The countdown lives in the menu bar, optionally with today’s completed count. Start, pause and skip are one click away.

Your data stays on your Mac

No sign-up, no ads, no third-party analytics. Focus records and settings are stored locally.

Timer

A classic rhythm, your way.

25-minute focus, 5-minute short break and 30-minute long break by default. The dots under the timer show where you are in the cycle.

  • Pause, resume, skip and restart
  • Optionally auto-start the next focus or break
  • A completion sound and system notification when each phase ends
  • In-app shortcuts: Space to start or pause, ⌘ , for Settings

Statistics

See your rhythm.

Click the chart button to switch between day, week, month and year in the same window — 24 hours, 7 days, every day of the month, or 12 months.

  • Switch between session count and net focus time
  • Hover over a bar to see its value
  • Only completed focus sessions count — breaks and abandoned sessions don’t

Sounds

A different sound for focus and for breaks.

Pick one sound for the end of focus and another for the end of a break, so you know what’s next without looking. 11 built-in sounds, simple volume levels, or none at all.
